Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a training program for payday lending employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a training program for payday lendingemployees; adding a new section to chapter 31.45 RCW; and making anappropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 31.45 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The director shall develop an internet-based education programfor the employees of a licensee that has a small loan endorsement. Theprogram must instruct employees about applicable state laws thatpertain to payday lending. (2) This section applies only to those employees who make smallloans and are involved in the making, approval, or collection of asmall loan. New employees must complete the program within six monthsafter the date they are hired. All employees must complete the programat least once every two years. (3) All required materials must be available via the internet. (4) The department must create an online system to track employeecompliance with the requirements in this section. (5) The director may adopt rules to implement this section.

The sum of forty thousand dollars, or asmuch thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal yearending June 30, 2007, from the general fund to the department offinancial institutions for the purposes of section 1 of this act.
